headline: Cambridge Trust discussed the City's portfolio review in an information-sharing session; no decisions were made.
summary: Eric Jussaume and Susan Martore-Baker of Cambridge Trust discussed the City of Nashua's portfolio review. A quorum was not present, so no votes were taken. The next meeting is set for October 14, 2026.
